item.title: Weird Faceted Plot
item.description:
I am hoping you guys might have a trick for making a faceted plot that plots a treatment and the control on each graph (see below for a mock up). I'm not sure how to do this in ggplot2 (or if it's even able to compute this using facet).
https://preview.redd.it/c5iijs1nsu1f1.png?width=958&format=png&auto=webp&s=1f10f8f93976daf050ef06fabdcbf4af00bebf25
My data frame looks like this. I just filter out the elements I am not plotting before graphing because it's easier.
https://preview.redd.it/cf2xu4gysu1f1.png?width=889&format=png&auto=webp&s=74c64b8745481d40c57e46b172f9f23c8c124a8a
If you can help at all, it would be appreciated!
